page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a high-density GPU-accelerated server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz with a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding 20.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it integrates four NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPUs providing a combined 320 GB of VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in memory bandwidth and data decompression, with small-block cached read bandwidth reaching 7649.82 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 615.79 GB/sec. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contributing to a PassMark CPU score of 85426.66 and an extended instructions score of 117918.35. For AI workloads, prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model achieves 10308.98 tokens/sec, while text generation reaches 377.14 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents a high-end resource tier designed for massive parallel processing and memory-intensive computations. The lack of local storage requires external storage attachments, which is a key architectural tradeoff to consider. This configuration is highly suited for large-scale machine learning, LLM inference, deep learning training, high-performance computing (HPC), and complex data science simulations.
